summary: Phase-1 build/run smoke test (backend + mobile web 390x844 on EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL). Backend: 19/20 pytest pass. Health, register (consent enforced, 409 on duplicate), login (401 on wrong password, admin blocked from the app login), auth/me, trip search Bengaluru->Chennai (2 seeded trips), trip detail (needs auth), publish a trip as driver@travoo.in, book and cancel (seats go down and come back, 409 on duplicate, 400 when booking your own trip), hire/drivers ([]), hire/local-drivers, identify-taluk, lgd and other hire endpoints all return 200. Admin login gives 200, but GET /api/admin/stats gives 403 'Please set a new password before using the admin portal' because the seeded admin has must_change_password=true. This is by design; I did not change the admin password. Mobile: language -> Continue -> /auth; register a new email user (the consent error shows, then success) -> role chooser modal -> passenger -> home; passenger login; search Bengaluru->Chennai shows '2 rides found'; the trip page loads; Confirm booking -> /booking/TRV-... shows Confirmed; cancelling in the UI shows Cancelled; Rent a Driver and Book a Driver screens open; taluk lookup works (Mysuru Taluk); 'View available drivers' calls /hire/local-drivers (200). No red screen, no page errors, no API errors >=400 in the UI flows.

minor.issue: Returns 403 until the seeded admin changes the password (must_change_password=true). This is expected, but it means the admin APIs can't be smoke-tested with the credentials in test_credentials.md. To unblock testing, either change the password once (POST /api/admin/auth/change-password) and update test_credentials.md, or accept this.
Rate limit is 10 logins per email per 15 min. Repeated test runs lock out the shared demo accounts (429). I cleared only my own rate_limits entries.

ui_bugs.issue: The map area (200px) was blank in the headless preview. The iframe srcdoc is there, but the Leaflet tiles/CDN did not show in the screenshot. This may be a headless/network artifact. Check it manually on a device.

action_items: Optional: let the admin change the password once (or document a non-forced admin test account) so admin/stats can be tested.
Optional: check manually that the trip route map renders on web.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/trips/{id} requires auth (401 without a token). This is fine because the app always sends one, but note it for API consumers.
server.py is 4059 lines and should be split. This is out of scope for Phase 1.

success_rate.backend: 95% (19/20; the only failure is admin/stats blocked by must_change_password, by design)
